name: Al Ghaniyy
description: Allah needs nothing from His creation; all creation depends on Him.
summary: The name Al Ghaniyy emphasizes Allah's self-sufficiency and independence from any external support. It reassures believers that Allah is the ultimate provider, in contrast to human dependency and need. The concept originates from the Quran, where Allah is described as possessing all wealth and sufficiency, highlighting His greatness and the assurance to His creation.
